<!--
  Dashboard counters in a row or a grid: tiles with an icon, a number and a caption, or compact figures. Axes:
  columns (2, 4), item (tile, compact), tone (default, muted), density (default, compact).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Metric } from "./metric-row.types";

export type MetricRowProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  metrics: Metric[];
  cols?: "2" | "4";
  item?: "tile" | "compact";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import StatTile from "../components/stat-tile.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  metrics,
  cols = "4",
  item = "tile",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<MetricRowProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Grid :cols="(((cols as string) === '2') ? '1-2' : '1-4')" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <template v-for="m in metrics" :key="m.id">
        <Box v-if="((item as string) === 'tile')" data-testid="item">
          <StatTile :label="m.label" :value="m.value" :icon="m.icon" :hint="m.hint" />
        </Box>
        <Stack v-else gap="0" class="rounded bg-card p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border" data-testid="item">
          <Group gap="2" align="center" class="text-muted-foreground">
            <LucideIcon :name="m.icon" :size="16" />
            <Text size="xs">
              {{ m.label }}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <Text size="2xl" weight="bold">
            {{ m.value }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ m.hint }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </template>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
